concepts.label: Predicted maturity
concepts.description: Predicted maturity date: next observation date if KO is predicted, otherwise contractual maturity.

concepts.label: Contractual maturity
concepts.description: Contractual (scheduled) maturity date of the ELI.
concepts.userText: No published view gives contractual maturity yet. I can show predicted maturity for Treasures (HK) instead.

concepts.label: Any underlying in the basket
concepts.description: Whether a stock is any underlying of the ELI's basket, not just the worst performer.
concepts.userText: I can only see the worst-performing stock of each ELI, not every stock in its basket, so I can't list all ELI that contain a stock. I can show ELI where it is the worst-performing stock.

concepts.label: Market spot scenario
concepts.description: Scenario multiplier on market prices used by the simulation views.
concepts.userText: Market scenarios (market spot) are not available in this version. I can show today's predicted results instead.
